scripts.smoke: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run check:migrations && npm run check:fixtures && npm run check:maestro && npm run check:policy-docs && npm run check:company && npm run check:claims && npm run check:backlog && npm run check:writes && npm run check:css-tokens && npm run check:mvp && npm test && npm run check:suites && npm run build:web
scripts.test:all: npm run smoke && npm run check:a11y && npm run test:db
scripts.test: npm run test:scripts && npm run test:plugins && npm run test:tools && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:tools: npm --prefix tools/bulk-import test && npm --prefix tools/menu-import test && npm --prefix tools/mirror-dish-images test && npm --prefix tools/upload-dish-images test
scripts.dev:mobile:staging: cp apps/mobile/.env.staging apps/mobile/.env && npm --prefix apps/mobile run start
scripts.dev:mobile:prod: cp apps/mobile/.env.production apps/mobile/.env && npm --prefix apps/mobile run start
scripts.ota:staging: npm run smoke && npm --prefix apps/mobile exec -- eas update --branch staging
scripts.ota:production: npm run smoke && npm --prefix apps/mobile exec -- eas update --branch production
